lines.zh: 我沿着潮线走，鼻端贴着湿沙。
lines.en: I walk the tide line, snout to wet sand.

lines.zh: 海嗣化的身子很重，每步都陷。
lines.en: This oceanized body is heavy; every step sinks.

lines.zh: 我嗅着沙里的旧骨，一步步挪。
lines.en: I sniff old bone in the sand and shuffle on.
Seaweed still clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 我的步子比原来的自己慢一倍。
lines.en: My stride is half the speed of what I was.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，沙都变黑。
lines.en: The sand darkens where I pass.
The stench of rot follows me.

lines.zh: 我不是从前的嗅探兽了。
lines.en: I am no longer the sniffer I was.

lines.zh: 我每挪一步，壳就响一下。
lines.en: Each shuffle, my shell creaks.

lines.zh: 我低着头，找埋在沙下的东西。
lines.en: Head low, I search what lies under the sand.

lines.zh: 我站着，鳃边有水珠滴下。
lines.en: I stand, water beading at my gills.

lines.zh: 这具身体一直在慢慢变。
lines.en: This body keeps slowly changing.
I can hear sounds from the sea floor.
I no longer need to speak.
Something moves in the seams of my shell.
I open my mouth and breathe out stench.

lines.zh: 我等着，潮会带来别的东西。
lines.en: I wait; the tide brings other things.
More joints than I remember having.
My shadow stretches long on the sand.

lines.zh: 海在很远的地方响一下。
lines.en: The sea sounds once, far away.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己还算不算动物。
lines.en: I do not know if I still count as an animal.
I lower my head and smell my own claw.

lines.zh: 这具躯壳在发热，又在发冷。
lines.en: This shell runs hot, then cold.

lines.zh: 我在等自己长出下一层皮。
lines.en: I wait for the next layer of skin.
Sand gets into the seams and itches.
I look up; the sky is grey.
You smell like sun-dried wood.
It takes me a long time to raise my head.
What brings you to the shore?
I am in no hurry to move.

lines.zh: 你比我小很多，但你不跑。
lines.en: You are much smaller, yet you do not run.
This shell was not like this before.
I know the beat of a living heart.
The sand you stand on is mine.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛太多了，看你看不清。
lines.en: I have too many eyes to see you clearly.
I sink another inch into the sand.
Hold still and let me smell you.
The sea calls me. So do you.
A crack opens in my shell.
Something rolls in my throat.
I grew used to this pain long ago.
Seventy-two health still holds.
Rot runs from the wound.
I step back and the sand sinks.

lines.zh: 这一下敲在壳的接缝上。
lines.en: That blow lands on a seam of my shell.
Something under my shell shifts.
This body will mend itself.
The shell took most of it.
Food? I prefer it alive.
That is not one chew for me.
You hold it out as if feeding fish.
Only the smell of rot appeals.
Freshwater things, I do not eat.
Drop it; it will sink into the sand.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔沙，不是这个味。
lines.en: I lick the sand; that is not the taste.
I am not hungry; I am growing.
Throw the meat further off.
That barely wets my throat.

lines.zh: 你撞在我壳上，声音很闷。
lines.en: You struck my shell with a dull sound.
All your force sinks into the sand.
Back off; the rim of my shell is hard.
I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 这一撞，惊动了壳里的东西。
lines.en: The bump stirred things inside my shell.
We have trodden the sand to muck.
One step closer and you are in my mouth.
I shift half a step and the ground creaks.
Your shoulder hit my gill.
One turn of my shell could pin you.
Seaborn do not need such bonds.
We only split and devour.
This body was never whole.
The call from the deep is closer than that.
You are asking the wrong creature.

lines.zh: 我在长新的东西，不是后代。
lines.en: What grows in me is not offspring.

lines.zh: 潮水会送来同类，不用找。
lines.en: The tide sends kin; no need to seek.

lines.zh: 我连自己的形状都不确定。
lines.en: I am not even sure of my own shape.
Do not speak of it beside my shell.
I only swallow what comes close.
I pick up a wet bone.
This shell is too thin.
My claw hooks onto it.
It dissolved in my mouth.
Kelp tangles around my foot.
This meat is still warm.

lines.zh: 我用鼻端把它推回坑里。
lines.en: I push it back into the pit with my snout.
It is stuck in a seam of my shell.
I lift it and look at it.
All of this belongs to the sea.
Something alive.
My gill covers open and rot spills out.
This smell is fresh.
One step reaches you.
Something reaches out from my seams.
The feelers by my gills all point at you.
You are inside my tide line.
I hear your heart speed up.
This beach offers no retreat.
I turn slowly toward you.
The rot inside me churns.
I will begin with you.
The sea pushes me toward you.
You carry the rust smell of iron.
Do not run; the sand will trip you.
I have prepared this step a long while.
Everything under my shell is awake.
You are a beginning.
I shuffle along your footprints.
Are you faster than the tide?
I keep watching your direction.
No hurry; this beach is wide.
The rot crawls along with me.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，你就不敢靠近。
lines.en: I stop, and you dare not come close.
You have gone behind the rocks.
My gills keep working.
I can smell your sweat.
Every time you look back, I am there.
This shell walks steadier than you.

lines.zh: 潮水在收，你没地方去了。
lines.en: The tide is going out; you have nowhere left.
I block the path stretch by stretch.
I remember every patch you tread.
I creep along the reef.
You look back, and I stop.
I endure longer than I look able to.
Behind you is the sea.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，你就没力气了。
lines.en: Wait a little longer and you will tire.

lines.zh: 最后的距离，我留给你跑。
lines.en: The last stretch, I let you run.
I bite down, and I have many teeth.
My claw passes and skin opens.

lines.zh: 七点伤害，对我来说很轻。
lines.en: Seven damage is light for me.
I drive my shelled shoulder forward.
The shell rim caught you. That hurts.
My teeth sink in and stay.
Rot seeps into the wound.
Back away three steps and I sheathe my claws.
My claws are harder than bone.
This one, I return to you.
You strike me; I strike back.
My arm rises slowly and falls fast.
One is not enough; then two.
You are shoved back several steps.
I am pushed up out of the waves.
Sand clings to this new shell.
My first breath is taken through gills.
I cannot recall my old shape.
The tide withdraws behind me.
My shell unfolds joint by joint.
I claim this beach.
The seaweed on me is still wet.
I raise my head and see land.

lines.zh: 陆地上全是能吃的东西。
lines.en: The land is full of things to eat.
My first action is to sniff.
This body is larger than the old one.
I step and the sand gives way.
The sea still calls me back.
I am not going back.
The water dripping from my gills is black.
I see living things in the distance.

lines.zh: 从这一步开始，陆地归海。
lines.en: From this step, the land belongs to the sea.
Small sounds come from under my shell.
I rise, slowly.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，发出腥味。
lines.en: Fire roasts my shell and it stinks.

lines.zh: 我重重摔在沙上，壳陷进去。
lines.en: I crash onto the sand and my shell sinks.

lines.zh: 水灌进鳃里，我反而更痛。
lines.en: Water floods my gills and it hurts more.
The blast shatters half my shell.

lines.zh: 箭头插进壳缝，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrowhead is stuck in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 有什么在我体内烧，和腐质打架。
lines.en: Something burns inside, fighting the rot.
Too hungry; my shell has gone soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在壳上，我整个抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and I shudder.
No sand below; I keep falling.
